decision: Code8192 gains 11 held-out agreements and removes 53 execution failures; code16384 gains 10 and removes 23. Both improve each held-out subset and qualify for short second-seed checks. Comments gains six agreements but ties one subset, missing the strict gate; its public score also falls from 70 to 65. Do not combine cleanup or extend it into a long run on this evidence. Prefer the cheaper 8k tokenizer for confirmation first. Public scores are 70, 86, 82 and 65; all are early scratch models, not replacements for the retained 573/960 best checkpoint (rank 8/15). No full training starts.
compute: The experiment driver took 858.86 seconds (14.31 minutes), excluding allocation, Drive reconnect and dependency setup. Colab showed an allocated GPU period of roughly 13:26–13:43 (minute precision). GPU median activity was 97%, mean 73.38%, peak sampled memory 22,739 MiB. The runtime was released automatically; Manage Sessions showed no active sessions. All four checkpoints and receipts are stored in Drive. T4 timing is unverified. At logged step 2,000, cleanup took 190.8 seconds versus 167.2 for control, so this implementation did not speed training. These training-loop times include CPU input preparation and exclude checkpoint export.
